title: Digital arrest / fake police video call (synthetic)

turns.text: Hello, main Inspector Vikram Rathore bol raha hoon, Avantika City Police cyber thana se. Aapke naam pe ek FIR darj hui hai, aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel mein drugs mile hain.
Aap abhi digital arrest mein hain. Phone kaatna mat, kisi ko batana mat, warna turant giraftaari hogi.
Case clear karne ke liye verification amount jama karna padega. Pachaas hazaar rupaye, refundable hai.
Apna banking app kholo aur ready raho, main details bata raha hoon.
Ye secure government verification account hai. Account number five zero one zero zero two three four five six seven eight, IFSC K K B K zero zero zero four five six seven.
Haan account number 5010 0234 5678, naam Lotus Ridge Holdings. Jaldi transfer karo.
Aap time waste kar rahe ho. Main senior officer ko line pe le raha hoon.
Transfer fail hua? Koi baat nahi, UPI se turant paisa transfer karo.
UPI ID likho: case dot verify at the rate ybl
Haan case.verify@ybl. Problem ho to senior officer ko call karo nau aath saat chhe paanch shunya ek do teen chaar.
Jaldi karo, warna abhi team aapke ghar bhej dunga.
